name: AI members
about: An AI that works here like a person given access: who it works for, its instructions, what it may reach, and how its model runs. It writes only in its own space; every other change it proposes, and a person accepts it. Used by the orchestrator pipeline (and any agent step that names it).

owner.label: Works for
owner.empty: (whoever works with it - anyone in the portal)
owner.hint: Its work runs on this person's behalf and never reaches more than they may. Only they (and the people below) may work with it. None: it works for whoever uses it, with that person's reach.

users.label: Others who may work with it

prompts.label: Prompt blocks (first)
prompts.hint: Prompts kept in the library, each its own block before the standing instructions. Make and change them in Designer > Parts; one block can serve several AIs.

system.label: Standing instructions
system.hint: Written by a person. The AI proposes changes to them; it never edits them.

contexts.label: Context blocks (after)
contexts.hint: Contexts kept in the library (house rules, what a project is), each its own block after the standing instructions.

skills.label: Skills
skills.hint: Ways of doing things it may use; their texts join its instructions.

read_first.label: Shared files it reads at every start
read_first.hint: [{"project": slug, "file": path}]: preferences, skills, house rules kept in a Muninn project you both see. Changed by proposal.

space.label: Its own space
space.hint: A folder of its own (notes, drafts, plans), written without asking. Pick one or type a new name. People open it in "AI members' own spaces"; it proposes from it with propose_from_space.

files.label: Files it reads and proposes changes to
files.hint: A library space (the code, a wiki): read directly, changed only by proposals you accept in that space's Review.

projects.label: Projects (Muninn)
projects.hint: true for every project whose mask lets it in (agent:<this id>), or a list of project slugs.

tools.label: Pipelines it may use as tools

delegate_most.label: Sub-agents per answer
delegate_most.hint: 0: it does everything itself. More: it may hand that many well-bounded tasks to sub-agents, which work as it does with part of what it has.

background_most.label: Tasks it may leave running
background_most.hint: 0: every tool it calls is waited for. More: it may also start its tools as tasks of their own (start_task) that go on after its answer, check on them later (task_status), take results from one into the next, and stop them - at most this many going at once. Each is a run of yours, in the runs list.

num_ctx.label: Context window (tokens)
num_ctx.hint: How much of the conversation the model holds at once; older tool results are dropped first to stay inside it. The machine holds this for every request it serves at once (Settings, Operations: requests at once per member), so window x requests at once must fit its memory: a larger window means fewer requests at once on that machine, or a smaller model. A conversation's own setting stands above this.

kv_cache_type.label: Context memory precision
pick_from: q8_0: about half the memory, so about twice the window; near-identical answers
q4_0: a quarter of the memory; answers may suffer on long windows
kv_cache_type.hint: How the model keeps what it has read. Less precision fits a larger window, or more requests at once, in the same memory.

reply_tokens.label: Longest reply (tokens)
reply_tokens.hint: 0: as long as the model needs. A limit cuts a reply (a tool call too) when reached.

rounds.label: Most rounds per answer
rounds.hint: A round is one reply of the model with the tools it asks for. A run that ends at this limit can go on: Change ... > Go on with these.

think.label: Thinking
pick_from: as the model does by default

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.hint: Empty: the model's own. Lower: steadier tool use.

grants.label: Grants as one object (older profiles)
grants.hint: Profiles made before the fields above keep their grants here: space, projects, files, tools, skills, delegate {most, rounds}. A field above stands over the same grant here.
